text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After training with Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay, finished!!
Great job, everyone!!
choice_data_list: Make sure you cool down properly.
Make sure you cool down properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, leave it to meee!
I will get it done perfectlyâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... *wheeze*... haaah~...
J-Just 20 more laps~... haaah~..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Oh, you must be exhausted, yes!?
Are you alright!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wahya!? T-T-T-Taiki-san!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! It's just some self-practice!
So it's really nothing, um... someone like me doesn't deserve...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, please don't mind me~~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ......Hmmmm, mm!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I have a request!
Could we do our cool-down a little later, PLEASE?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Doto is obviously overworking herself!
It happens all the time with her. That's why I...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I will run with all my might and give her a hug!
I will put her to rest with these very arms!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I will run with all my might and give her a hug!
I will put her to rest with these very arms!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I knew you'd say that,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then I'll go give it my allll!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Taiki Shuttle sprinted at full speed and caught Meisho Doto. It seems she safely managed to get her to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested asking other Trainers for help
so Meisho Doto could get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I see!
Everyone protecting Doto... it's a mission, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, Trainer!
You're the brains of this operation!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We will definitely make this mission a SUCCESS!
I'm counting on youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Meisho Doto was safely put to rest
with everyone's help.
Taiki Shuttle looked quite satisfied as well.
